newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber retreat as cash fails to rise.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber retreat as cash fails to rise.

text.p: CME lumber futures retreated Friday and closed lower after closing sharply higher to limit up on Thursday.

Cash markets failed to show anticipated gains when word circulated Thursday that activity had picked up in the cash market. Actually, cash prices eased instead as mills looked to fill orders and this prompted general selling interest in futures, traders said.
Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $384 per tbf, down $4 from midweek and $13 under last week's level.
Futures closed $7.00 to $2.60 per tbf lower with limitless May off most at $392.50 and July off $3.50 at $391.00 per tbf.
